chapter_title_en: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas — The Walled Village
chapter_seo_title: Han Li's Powerless Survival in the Nether Yin Land – RMJI Ch 589
chapter_meta_description: Stripped of all magic power, Han Li enters a hostile new world. A walled village, Yin Beasts, and the Spirit Void Eruption force him to rely on cold calculation alone for survival.
og_title: Han Li’s Worst Nightmare: Stranded Without Magic in the Yin Wasteland
og_description: A once-in-a-century disaster strips Han Li of everything but his wits. Welcome to the survival arc of the Mortal Stream.
twitter_title: Cultivator Without Magic: Han Li’s Ultimate Test Begins
twitter_description: Han Li is thrown into a Yin-infested wasteland with zero mana. Can a dead zone forge an even sharper blade?

lore_anchors.definition: A rare natural disaster that floods a region with absolute spiritual vacuum, nullifying all magic power in its wake.
A realm of pure, concentrated Yin energy that suppresses Yang-aligned life force and disables standard cultivation techniques.
A creature born of concentrated Yin energy, highly aggressive and lethal to cultivators whose magic is sealed.
An otherworldly wind associated with death and ghostly presences in Chinese folklore; exposure is often fatal to the unprepared.
